# Demo Embed Snippets

Pre-built embed code for the Open Helplines demo video/GIF.

**Assets** (generated by `examples/web/scripts/record-demo.mjs` + `scripts/convert-demo.sh`):

| File | Size | Dimensions | Duration | Use |
|:-----|-----:|:----------:|:--------:|:----|
| `public/assets/demo.webm` | ~1.2 MB | 1280×800 | ~80 s | Source / archival |
| `public/assets/demo.mp4`  | ~504 KB | 1280×800 | ~80 s | X/Twitter, LinkedIn |
| `public/assets/demo.gif`  | ~296 KB | 640×400  |  50 s | README embed, HN |

## Hacker News "Show HN" post

**Title:**

```
Show HN: Open Helplines – open data registry of crisis helplines (CC0, MCP-ready)
```

**Body:**

```
Open Helplines is a free, CC0-licensed registry of mental-health and crisis
helplines for 80+ countries. No API key, no tracking.

Features demoed in the GIF:
  • 3D globe with per-country panels (Three.js)
  • Force-directed network graph (D3)
  • Heatmap with time-slider
  • Emergency banner on trigger queries (e.g. ?q=suicide)
  • Privacy-first crisis finder (local search, no server calls)
  • i18n: en · ja · es
  • MCP server for AI assistants

Repo: https://github.com/Kouki-odaka/open-helplines
Live: https://kouki-odaka.github.io/open-helplines/en/globe
```

## Regenerating assets

```bash
# 1. Record (≈ 80 s runtime)
node examples/web/scripts/record-demo.mjs

# 2. Convert (requires ffmpeg)
bash examples/web/scripts/convert-demo.sh

# To record against local dev server instead of GitHub Pages:
node examples/web/scripts/record-demo.mjs --url http://localhost:3000
```
